title.zh-CN: 更换肿瘤药物后反复发热与肺部阴影
title.en: Recurrent fever and pulmonary opacities after a change in cancer treatment

summary.zh-CN: 接受肿瘤治疗的患者反复发热，症状与停药、再用药的关系和肺部证据需要共同分析。
summary.en: A patient receiving cancer therapy has recurrent fever requiring joint analysis of the drug timeline and pulmonary evidence.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: Current DailyMed everolimus prescribing information checked 2026-10-28; scope non-infectious pneumonitis, opportunistic infection differential and severity-based interruption/discontinuation. Label guidance, not an asserted society-guideline edition.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 重建停药及再暴露时间关系。
识别药物肺损伤的证据强度。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess evidence strength for drug-related lung injury.

按严重度讨论安全停药与复用边界。
learningOutcomes.en: Discuss severity-based interruption and re-exposure boundaries.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 再次用药后发热咳嗽约六周，抗菌治疗效果不佳
chiefComplaint.en: Fever and cough for about six weeks after restarting treatment, with little response to antibiotics

triageNote.zh-CN: 先重建药物暴露和症状时序，再核对肺部记录。
triageNote.en: Reconstruct medication exposure and symptom timing before interpreting pulmonary records.

openingLine.zh-CN: 十二年前左肾透明细胞癌切除，两年前肺与纵隔转移经活检证实。

question.zh-CN: 肿瘤治疗的背景是什么？

answer.zh-CN: 十二年前左肾透明细胞癌切除，两年前肺与纵隔转移经活检证实。
answer.en: Left clear-cell renal carcinoma was resected twelve years earlier; lung and mediastinal metastases were biopsy-confirmed two years earlier.

question.zh-CN: 第一次用新药后出现过什么？
question.en: What happened after the first exposure to the new drug?

answer.zh-CN: 索拉非尼因皮疹及淋巴结进展停用，改依维莫司两周后发热咳嗽；青霉素效果差，停药并短期激素后体温及胸片改善。
answer.en: Sorafenib was stopped after rash and nodal progression. Fever and cough began two weeks after everolimus; penicillin helped little, while withdrawal with a short steroid course improved temperature and chest radiography.

question.en: How soon did fever recur after restarting?

answer.zh-CN: 再次服依维莫司约一周后发热38–39℃，伴畏寒、乏力和肌肉酸痛。
answer.en: About one week after restarting everolimus, fever 38–39°C recurred with chills, fatigue and myalgia.

question.zh-CN: 这次还有哪些呼吸症状？
question.en: What respiratory symptoms accompanied this episode?

answer.zh-CN: 咳少量白痰、轻度胸闷气促，无胸痛、咯血或盗汗。
answer.en: There was scant white sputum with mild chest tightness and dyspnoea, without chest pain, haemoptysis or night sweats.

maneuver.zh-CN: 核对生命体征及胸部体征
maneuver.en: Review vital signs and chest findings

finding.zh-CN: 体温38.4℃、脉搏116次/分、呼吸16次/分、血压130/90 mmHg；双肺呼吸音粗，未闻明显干湿啰音，无发绀和下肢水肿。
finding.en: Temperature 38.4°C, pulse 116/min, respiratory rate 16/min and pressure 130/90 mmHg; coarse breath sounds without clear added sounds, cyanosis or leg oedema.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 白细胞10.3×10^9/L、中性84.1%，CRP14.8 mg/L、ESR47 mm/h；pH7.42、PaCO2 33 mmHg、PaO2 79.9 mmHg。CT双肺斑片影进展；支原体、衣原体和结核抗体阴性，不能据此排除机会感染。
text.en: White count 10.3×10^9/L, neutrophils 84.1%, CRP 14.8 mg/L and ESR 47 mm/h; pH 7.42, PaCO2 33 mmHg and PaO2 79.9 mmHg. Bilateral patchy CT opacities progressed; negative mycoplasma, chlamydia and tuberculosis antibodies do not exclude opportunistic infection.

name.en: Short inpatient response and diagnostic gaps

zh-CN: 住院短期反应与诊断缺口
en: Short inpatient response and diagnostic gaps

text.zh-CN: 住院采用泼尼松，未继续抗生素，三天后体温正常、咳嗽减轻、CT影吸收。未提供支气管肺泡灌洗、肺组织病理或完整机会感染检查；第二次具体停药时间未明确。
text.en: Prednisone was used without continuing antibiotics; after three days temperature normalised, cough improved and CT opacities regressed. Bronchoalveolar lavage, lung histology and a full opportunistic-infection work-up were not supplied; timing of a second drug withdrawal was not explicit.

text.zh-CN: 报告三天后退热、咳嗽减轻、CT改善；未给长期肺功能、肿瘤疗效、感染终审或后续依维莫司处置。
text.en: Defervescence, reduced cough and CT improvement were reported after three days; long-term lung function, cancer outcomes, final infection exclusion and later everolimus decisions were not supplied.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前药物时序和肺部证据最支持哪项工作判断？
prompt.en: Which working interpretation best fits the drug timeline and pulmonary evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑依维莫司相关肺炎，同时保留感染与肿瘤进展的鉴别
text.en: Strongly suspect everolimus-associated pneumonitis while retaining infection and tumour progression in the differential

feedback.zh-CN: 停药改善和再暴露复发增强关联，但不消除免疫抑制患者感染风险。
feedback.en: Improvement after withdrawal and recurrence after re-exposure strengthen association without removing infection risk.

text.zh-CN: 三项抗体阴性证明肺部无感染
text.en: Three negative antibodies prove there is no lung infection

feedback.zh-CN: 这些检查不能涵盖全部病原或PJP。
feedback.en: These tests do not cover all organisms or Pneumocystis.

text.zh-CN: 有转移史就只能解释为肿瘤进展
text.en: A metastatic history means the opacities must be tumour progression

feedback.zh-CN: 药物时间关系和既往回退现象需要纳入。
feedback.en: The medication timeline and prior regression must be considered.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 再次迅速改善支持炎症性药物反应，但激素反应不是病原排除试验
text.en: Rapid improvement again supports an inflammatory drug reaction, but steroid response is not an infection-exclusion test

feedback.zh-CN: 临床关联较强，病因确证仍受缺少灌洗和病理限制。
feedback.en: The clinical association is strong, but absent lavage and pathology limit confirmation.

text.zh-CN: 激素三天有效即可证明绝无感染
text.en: Three-day steroid response proves infection is impossible

feedback.zh-CN: 短期抑炎反应不能替代微生物评估。
feedback.en: Short-term anti-inflammatory response does not replace microbiology.

text.zh-CN: 本例反应可确定所有患者的固定激素剂量
text.en: This response establishes a fixed steroid dose for every patient

feedback.zh-CN: 严重程度、感染风险和个体状况不同。
feedback.en: Severity, infection risk and individual circumstances differ.

prompt.zh-CN: 按当前药品安全资料，下一步应强调什么？
prompt.en: What should be prioritised according to current medicine-safety information?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 暂停可疑药并由肿瘤与呼吸团队按严重度评估，排查机会感染后决定激素及后续用药
text.en: Withhold the suspected drug and arrange oncology/respiratory severity assessment, including opportunistic infection, before deciding steroids and future therapy

feedback.zh-CN: 现行标签将非感染性肺炎列为风险；停药或永久停用按严重度，不能无监测再挑战。
feedback.en: Current labelling recognises non-infectious pneumonitis; interruption or discontinuation depends on severity, without unmonitored rechallenge.

text.zh-CN: 为证实因果立即自行再次服用
text.en: Immediately restart independently to prove causality

feedback.zh-CN: 重复暴露可造成更严重肺损伤。
feedback.en: Repeated exposure can cause more severe lung injury.

text.zh-CN: 因旧文抗体阴性，激素前不必考虑PJP
text.en: Negative historical antibodies remove the need to consider PJP before steroids

feedback.zh-CN: 抗体项目未覆盖该机会感染。
feedback.en: Those antibodies do not assess this opportunistic infection.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.en: Avoid unprotected re-exposure and include opportunistic infection in pneumonitis assessment

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明药物时序比单次发热更有区分力。；承认缺少灌洗、组织学、完整机会感染检测、吸氧条件和长期随访。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Drug timing discriminates better than a single fever episode.; acknowledge Lavage, histology, complete opportunistic-infection testing, oxygen conditions and long-term follow-up are absent. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告以停药改善及再用复发支持依维莫司相关肺损伤，仍缺少完整感染排除及组织证据。
conclusion.en: Withdrawal improvement and recurrence on re-exposure support everolimus-associated lung injury, with incomplete infection exclusion and tissue evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 药物时序比单次发热更有区分力。
keyReasoning.en: Drug timing discriminates better than a single fever episode.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗体阴性不能覆盖机会感染。
keyReasoning.en: Negative antibodies do not cover opportunistic infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 激素反应支持但不能确证病因。
keyReasoning.en: Steroid response supports but does not prove aetiology.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不需为教学目的再次挑战可疑药。
teachingPoints.en: Teaching does not require another challenge with a suspected drug.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 吸入氧条件未提供，不能计算可靠氧合分级。
teachingPoints.en: Inspired oxygen conditions are absent, preventing reliable oxygenation grading.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 现行标签与个案历史剂量应分开。
teachingPoints.en: Current labelling and historical case doses must be separated.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少灌洗、组织学、完整机会感染检测、吸氧条件和长期随访。
